title: personal-llm-experiment-mini-tracker-evelyn-2026
content:
Experiment mini-sheet - Evelyn Park

Columns: run_id | date | model | variant | quant | batch_size | seq_len | p50_ms | p90_ms | throughput_tok_s | cost_per_1k_tokens | notes

R1 | 2026-02-10 | redwood/rw-7b | fp16 | none | 1 | 512 | 38 | 95 | 2100 | $0.85 | baseline hosted API
R2 | 2026-02-12 | redwood/rw-7b | int8 | awq | 4 | 512 | 52 | 140 | 7600 | $0.32 | int8 reduces cost, p90 regs
R3 | 2026-02-16 | redwood/rw-7b | int4 | qlora | 8 | 128 | 18 | 42 | 11,200 | $0.15 | small seq faster; quality check needed
R4 | 2026-02-20 | llama2-13b | fp16 | none | 2 | 512 | 140 | 320 | 850 | $1.60 | too slow for low-latency route
R5 | 2026-02-24 | redwood/rw-7b | int4 | per-channel | 16 | 64 | 9 | 22 | 22,500 | $0.09 | great throughput, watch degredation on long prompts
R6 | 2026-02-28 | redwood/rw-7b | int8 | awq | 4 | 1024 | 86 | 220 | 4,900 | $0.27 | high seq_len increases p90 significantly

Quick notes:
- Test config: latency measured on Dedicated pool (g4dn equivalent). Throughput computed as tokens generated per second during steady-state stream.
- Cost calc: unit cost estimated from Dedicated reserved pricing + infra amortized; approximate for comparison only.
- Observed issue: int8 AWQ shows occasional p90 spikes correlated with cache misses (see experiment logs in Jira MLINF-867).
- Quality check: run R3 and R5 against eval prompt set (eval-suite/semantic-coherence) and collect rouge/BLEU + human spot checks.
